notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Inline was just updated to version 1.0.6.

-Fixed an issue with a few steam achievements that could be randomly earned when loading a game. Mostly had to do with steam stats not tracking the number of shapes placed in a game due to an issue on our side.

-Fixed some achievements that were unobtainable

-Fixed a bug where custom games with a preview queue of 0 or 1 could not be resumed as there would be no shape in the spawn zone.
